governing_rule: No normative change without demonstrated evidence

candidates.title: Stable discovery-event identity
candidates.problem_statement: Repeated exports create new ITC identifiers without a stable identity for the underlying discovery event.

candidates.title: Explicit constraint-state semantics
candidates.problem_statement: Null and empty constraint values conflate unknown, not configured, default applied, not applicable, and unavailable states.

candidates.title: Privacy-preserving evidence receipt
candidates.problem_statement: Internal evidence references explain provenance but cannot presently support bounded independent verification.

candidates.title: Empirical minimality testing
candidates.problem_statement: The current schema is declared minimal, but field-removal testing has not established the smallest practical interoperable handoff.
